body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> E-Filliate introduced its single cable solution for cables up to ten feet in length at the pre-press event '2009 CES Unveiled'. Shipped as a compact one-foot-long coiled cable, it can be stretched out to ten feet; once stretched, it holds its shape and will not recoil.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, Jb Shim, Gini Shim >
